prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent PNG layered sprite assembly kit for a friendly comic wild boar in the exact warm brown fur / dark mane / ivory tusks art style of the reference. This is a paper-puppet style GAME ANIMATION RIG, not a sequence of whole-body poses.
Exactly FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 separate sprite parts with generous transparent gutters, no labels. All parts in a row have the SAME scale.
Column 1: one complete torso + head + mane + tail as a single layer, NO legs and NO hooves attached, clean furry underside; a rounded seamless cartoon body shape meant to cover the tops of leg layers.
Column 2: one straight near front leg, from rounded furry shoulder attachment to dark hoof.
Column 3: one straight near rear leg, from rounded furry hip attachment to dark hoof.
Column 4: one straight far front leg, same shape as front leg but subtly darker.
Column 5: one straight far rear leg, same shape as rear leg but subtly darker.
These are harmless independent animation layers, not an anatomical illustration. Each leg is drawn upright in its neutral hanging pose, rounded fur at top with overlap for assembling beneath body. Legs must be short, sturdy boar legs, not human legs. Total leg height about one third of the body's horizontal length. Torso size identical between all rows.
Row1: southeast front-right three-quarter view (snout pointing right and slightly toward viewer).
Row2: southwest front-left three-quarter view.
Row3: northeast back-right three-quarter view (rump toward viewer, snout right away from viewer).
Row4: northwest back-left three-quarter view.
Keep all body and matching leg perspectives coherent. Detailed Maifeld comic game pixel art, warm chestnut fur, muted dark outlines, warm upper-left lighting. No gradients in background, no cast shadow, no text, no grid. Genuine transparent background. Landscape 1536x1024. Keep the reference's friendly chunky proportions. Do not include assembled animals; output only the requested 5 parts in each row.
